Are you looking for a new challenge in the logistics sector?Do you enjoy working in a friendly and supportive team and are you willing to work in two shifts with bonuses up to 150%? Then this warehouse position at AS Watson or Kruidvat might be perfect for you! Keep reading!

As an order picker/warehouse employee, you’ll be responsible for collecting orders using a voice-picking system, which can be set in multiple languages, including Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with your team, you’ll make sure all orders are ready on time for stores in the Netherlands and Belgium.

You’ll use your organizational skills to efficiently load products onto pallets. These pallets can include items like toothpaste, shampoo, cleaning supplies, toys, and clothing. Since no two pallets are the same, every day brings new challenges.

At AS Watson, you’ll work in a two-shift schedule and receive attractive bonuses of up to 150% per hour for late shifts. Plus, you’ll be part of a friendly team where collaboration is key.

- You work accurately and take responsibility
- Willing to work in two shifts (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00)
- Flexible availability, part-time options possible
- Minimum availability on Mondays and Tuesdays, plus two Saturday mornings per month
- Own transportation required, as the location is not easily accessible by public transport
